meta.title: Iron Coach — Ironman California 2027
meta.raceDateNote: Target ~Oct 24, 2027 — confirm when registration opens; 2026 race is Oct 18
meta.goal: Finish under cutoff with enjoyable training (not podium)
meta.courseMapsNote: Maps subject to change / 2025–26 reference until 2027 maps publish

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Rebuild consistency with easy aerobic volume across run, bike, and swim. Establish habits, mobility, and nutrition logging.

phases.name: Base
phases.description: Build durable aerobic fitness. Gradually increase long rides and runs while keeping intensity mostly easy. Friel Base 1–2: Nov 30 test week (Dec 1 run LTHR test, Dec 5 bike LTHR test), 2 load + 1 recovery week cycles, 2× weekly Anatomical Adaptation strength.

phases.name: Specific
phases.description: Race-specific sessions: longer bricks, swim continuity, and controlled intensity that mirrors Ironman demands.

phases.name: Peak
phases.description: Highest race-relevant volume and key rehearsals before taper. Sharpen confidence, not grind.

phases.name: Taper
phases.description: About 2.5 weeks of reduced volume, retained sharpness, travel prep, and race-week nutrition.
